status: Prospective scale-up screen, not executed on CUDA yet
dataset: CIFAR-10 official 50000 training examples split into 45000 train and 5000 validation; official test held separately
architecture: torchvision ResNet-18 from scratch, original channel widths, 3x3 stride-1 CIFAR stem, no maxpool, 10-way shared head
task_type: Domain-incremental: same classes and examples under rotations, no task identity at inference, no replay
noise: Fresh IID N(0,1) RGB inputs and independent uniform labels at every step
batchnorm_control: All warm-up conditions use batch statistics. Reset running buffers and recalibrate on the same 640 unlabeled task-0 training images after preparation. Reset optimizer at every real-task boundary. BN affine parameters are retained.
augmentation: None; preserve the PoC intervention while increasing data and training duration.
evaluation: Validation during training. Official test accessed only by finalize after all six runs; also report 9000 examples excluded from the earlier 1000-example PoC test.
extra_diagnostic: No oracle BN recalibration in the main scale-up.
limitations: Two seeds; artificial same-class domain shifts; not class-incremental. Data size, duration, real-data batch size and device differ from PoC. No novelty claim. No fully untouched official-test claim: 1000 test images were used in PoC.
scheduler: Constant learning rate, as in PoC; learning-rate and regularization controls reserved for a subsequent frozen protocol.
precision: FP32; TF32 disabled; no AMP in this replication screen.
progression_rule: Evaluate paired effects in both seeds, along with acquisition accuracy; no p-values. If only ECE improves, pursue calibration rather than a forgetting claim. Do not add seeds or tune based on final test.
